proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: start from the general pullback map from the pullback section of Sites and claim it carries the lower shriek subsheaf into the corresponding subsheaf after base change and induces the isomorphism; on stalks the pullback compatibility is displayed in a commutative square whose maps are all given by pulling back local sections; the cartesian property identifies the fibres, and the stalk description of lower shriek along separated morphisms (with its proof) supplies the displayed diagram in which the inner horizontal arrows are isomorphisms, the right vertical arrows are equalities, and the four corner arrows are injective, yielding a unique dotted bijection; the subsheaf statement and the isomorphism then follow from exactness of stalks (source lines 776-829)

core_obligations: Set up the claim: the general pullback map restricts to a map from g^{-1}f_!F into f'_!(g')^{-1}F and induces the isomorphism of the lemma (proof lines 777-782).

Check the stalk compatibility: the four maps of the first displayed square are given by pulling back local sections along morphisms of schemes commuting with the square, and the fibres agree because the square is cartesian (proof lines 784-803).

Conclude on stalks: combine the stalk description of lower shriek along separated morphisms with the displayed big diagram, use the stated arrow properties to obtain the unique dotted bijection, and deduce the subsheaf inclusion and the isomorphism by exactness of stalks (proof lines 804-828).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to the general pullback map (proof lines 777-782).
Stalk compatibility from displayed squares (proof lines 784-803).
Stalk diagram with unique dotted bijection and conclusion (proof lines 804-828).
